title: Active-drainage E3/P4 replay with G12A local groundwater authority
question: With the G12 one-shot href calibration removed from the acceptance logic, do the unchanged E3_MAP physical tangent and P4 safeguard converge on the MAP09 active-drainage real-SWAP carrier when each MODFLOW regime uses its independently qualified G12A local groundwater response?

rule: For each of GW_R05_STORAGE, GW_R2_STORAGE and GW_MIXED use the persisted G12A one-shot bias, sy, local slope a and q_at_href.
Before policy replay, remeasure the same seven fixed q probes with the unchanged one-shot bias.
Require positive slope and max centered local affine fit error <=1e-16 m/s.
Require remeasured slope to agree with G12A within 1e-8 relative and q_at_href within 2e-16 m/s absolute.
Do not modify the bias to force q_swap(href)=q_gw(href).

reference_root.rule: Require both bracket heads participant-status 0 and a sign change or exact zero. Perform 50 fixed bisections from immutable SWAP origin.

tangent: Use G12 E3_MAP unchanged, including its fixed scale ladder, stencil-internal execution class, and <=5% adjacent-scale consistency rule.

policies.P1_E3_MAP: Raw physical Newton with E3_MAP re-estimated at each iterate.
policies.P4_E3_MAP: Same proposal with unchanged factor-1/2 backtracking until participant status 0 and local-groundwater residual magnitude does not increase.

required_gates: MAP09 active-drainage carrier authority and immutable origin reproduce.
E3_MAP is AVAILABLE at href and both frozen starts.
All three G12A local groundwater responses remeasure within the frozen fit/authority tolerances.
A reference root is obtained inside the frozen +/-1e-6 bracket for every regime.
P4 converges from both frozen starts in all three regimes within 12 outer iterations and final head is within 5e-10 m of the independent reference root.
P1 outcomes, P4 contractions and inadmissible raw proposals are recorded without being required for PASS.
All SWAP diagnostics and rejected candidates are discarded; accepted revision/time/ledger remain unchanged.
interpretation: G12B is separate evidence and cannot retroactively pass G12.
PASS would extend E3/P4 research qualification to the frozen MAP09 active-drainage process configuration across three groundwater response classes.
PASS would leave estimator computational cost and production integration/ownership as open gates.
No production HCOF/RHS or production coupling source change is authorized.
